Guides / Friends & trading / Night Market & Glimmer

Night Market & Glimmer

Sell rare finds for Glimmer, buy from other trainers, and the Glimmer Shop.

GlimmerSelling and buyingAuction HouseGlimmer Shop

The Night Market opens with your 3rd badge (online). Trainers put their rare finds up for Glimmer, and anyone can buy them.

Glimmer

  • Earned once for each special in your PC when your PC snapshot goes online: Shiny 10, Void 30, Prismatic 80, Perfect IVs 10, Alpha 10 (added up), ×3 for a Legendary or Mythical.
  • And from your Night Market sales. Glimmer also buys extra Raid Passes.

Selling and buying

  • Only rare finds can be listed: a Shiny, Void, Prismatic, Gilded, Mirage, Perfect, Alpha or a Legendary / Mythical.
  • Price 10–9,999,999 Glimmer; the market keeps a 5% fee. Up to 10 listings at once (more with Bigger stall); a listing lasts 7 days.
  • A listed Pokémon leaves your PC until it sells or you take it down; bought Pokémon arrive in your PC.
  • Change your price any time without taking the listing down: the pencil on your stall slot, or "Price" in your listing's card. It stays the same listing (same start and end time, Spotlight kept). Up to 10 price changes an hour.
  • Taking a listing down and putting it back up has a short cooldown, so changing the price is the quicker way.
  • Search the Stalls by species, look, Legendary, Perfect and price; the Record board shows the top sales.

New trainers can buy right away, but selling opens 2 days after you start playing online.

Auction House

Night Market → Auctions: put a rare find up for bids instead of a fixed price.

  • Pick a starting bid (at least the market's lowest price for that look) and a length: 12, 24 or 48 hours.
  • A 2% listing fee (at least 50 Glimmer) is kept; 8% of the final price goes to the market when it sells.
  • Bids are a maximum: the Auction House bids for you, one step at a time, up to your max. The Glimmer for your max is held while you're on top and comes straight back if someone outbids you.
  • The winner's Pokémon arrives in their market mail. Filter the board by name, type, look, Legendary, price or no bids yet, and sort by ending soon, newest, top bid, lowest price, rarest or most bids.
